entities.name: Yvon Beliën
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yvon Beliën was a Dutch volleyball player, who plays as a Center. She played for River Volley Piacenza. In 2015, she played with the Dutch National Team at the 2015 European Games in Baku, Azerbaijan. In 2016, she helped the Netherlands reach their first Olympic semifinals at the 2016 Summer Olympics, finishing fourth.
